A '''Maxillipede shuttle''' was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and used to carry out a [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module/Legends|mission]]. The leader of the mission was [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]], and the crew was made up of several droids, who were called the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]]. The ship had [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] markings, and it was painted in the "traditional" Separatist [[Color/Legends|colors]] white and dark blue/purple. It also has places for [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] to go and make external repairs to the ship.

==History==
After the shuttle was captured, it was used by [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] as a transport from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to the [[Aut-O's flagship/Legends|Separatist dreadnought]] that D-Squad was going to [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module/Legends|infiltrate]]. After it arrived at its destination, [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]], the pilot, set it on a collision course with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] ship. In response, the shuttle was pulled into the dreadnought hangar with a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. Several [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] came onto the ship to check for lifeforms, and escorted D-Squad off for interrogation. D-Squad was able to escape from their escort, however, obtain the [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]] they had come for, and escape on the shuttle into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] amidst the confusion they had caused.

While in hyperspace, the droids of D-Squad were working to repair one of their damaged comrades, [[M5-BZ/Legends|M5-BZ]], when they received a warning from the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] that they were going to travel into a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] starm. WAC-47 exited hyperspace into a multitude of icy chunks, which seriously damaged the ship. Some of the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] of D-Squad tried to repair the ship, and were able to bring back auxiliary power, but they had to return to the inside of the ship after one was knocked off into space and was saved only by a hastily extended magnetic cable. Unable to maneuver, the shuttle crashed in [[The Void/Legends|the Void]] on [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]]. D-Squad then left its wreckage behind to search for some means of rescue.
